Signed, home perspective (the week3-situational.jsonl convention). Walk-forward on 2025: Pearson r = 0.24135296163107084 vs home win, n=250 — the one family admitted to the tilt under the source doc's r > 0.03 rule.

edge_types.value_semantics: Home 4th-down go rate minus away go rate; go rate = (passes + runs) / (passes + runs + punts + field goals) on 4th down. Walk-forward on 2025: r = -0.01363209458605604, n=255 — below the source doc's 0.03 admission bar, so the family is DARK: the number is recorded on the edge, it is not treated as 'more aggressive is better', and it is not sign-flipped.

edge_types.status: MEASURED_DIAGNOSTIC — REFUSED as a scoring feature 2026-10-14; carried as roster fact

Those diagnostics scored RIL as a CRPS feature and REFUSED it (delta +0.004179, full-filter +0.003498); the refusal is recorded here as history. edge_types.value_semantics: Days between games for each team (nflverse rest convention, carried from games.jsonl rest_away/rest_home) and their difference, home minus away. Related measurement on file (not a graph weight): data/gse-dataset/current/environment-calibration.json measured rest_days_to_margin slope 0.4108 (n=544, 2024-25). The walk-forward CTF diagnostic (travel/rest/timezone) was REFUSED as a scoring feature (delta +0.000912) and failed closed on 739 rows with null travel/tz/rest — the same fail-closed posture this builder takes.

Related measurement on file: environment-calibration.json measured wind/temp effects on totals and set used_slope to 0.0 for both — recorded, not applied here.

edge_types.status: FORMALIZED_READ — proxy defined; statement log does not exist yet
edge_types.value_semantics: Whether a staff's stated process matches what it does, priced against what the market assumes. The census left this row with 'define measurable proxy' as its missing step; the proxy is defined here: for each public statement of game-plan emphasis by the staff in the current week (run/pass lean, tempo, personnel), mark it confirmed or contradicted by the observed play mix when the game is played, and carry the staff's rolling stated-vs-observed rate as the read's evidence. Until statements are logged with stamps, the edge cannot be computed — only read.

note: Every edge type the situational graph may carry. An edge type not in this registry cannot appear in a graph (graph.py validation). 'class' is one of: measured (computed from stamped data), measured_input (computed when a stamped input is supplied), formalized_read (an authored reasoning read, recorded — never generated by the builder), composite (derived from other edges' inputs). Status records what the fleet's own measurement history says about each family; status is a fact, not a verdict, and no status turns an edge into an emission.
